additional_info.subject: ID0376711-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R7 313065117146] Blackscreen problem CRM:00642001468
additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿Yunus,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Mohini
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Y2 / R7 313065117146
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
rMqpmt
Problem Description
:
Troubleshooting
:
According to the issue reported, the terminal screen is black. Following the suggested action on your side should help resolve the problem.
1. Please restart the charger.
2.You will need to change the shielded and shortened DP cable. Please replace the DP cable with a new 1.5m cable (Official Siemens spare part and NOT any other DP cable). Also please route the DP cable as far as possible from routers, R&D found out that this component is affecting the EMC performance.
3.Also please check the 24VDC power supply. it should be set to 25VDC.
Please find the work instruction for black screen issue and if you have any help, please reach out to us.
support.industry.siemens.com/cs/document/109816643/?lc=en-WW&dti=0&_nct=1724770262&si=true
For future reference, your ticket number is
0376711
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Mohini Patil
